note: All ten items below are frozen BEFORE any Phase A result is produced. After Phase A results exist, NONE of these may be modified (item 1). Ground-truth verified this session by fresh runtime introspection (_g4_introspect) + source reads, NOT by remembered APIs.

frozen_items.2_feature_order: The V2_PRIMARY_SEMANTIC_NAMES tuple order above is the exact column order (column_stack). stats block order = ccg.reliability.features.stat_feature_names() (17 cols). R2 = hstack(stats17_std, sem14_std).

3_normalization_procedure.fit: normalize_fit(concat(stats|sem over K5+K10 reliability_TRAIN rows), fit_rows=all, keys=feature names)
3_normalization_procedure.apply: normalize_apply to every K block; (x-mean)/(std+1e-8), ddof=0
3_normalization_procedure.isolation: separate fit per backbone / per scorer_seed / per model family; never shared across backbone or seed

4_c_grid.selection: _tune_mean_auroc over Random K5+K10 on reliability_TUNE rows
4_c_grid.tie_break: within SELECTION_TIE=0.002 prefer the smaller (earlier) C
4_c_grid.applies_to: both R1 (stats) and R2 (stats+semantic); fitted fresh per backbone/seed (NOT apply_frozen / NOT V1 phase05 chosen C)

5_selection_split.train: reliability_train (val_calib images, train_frac 0.70, seed 20260928) Random K5/K10

6_random_hard_manifests.cohort: ccg.semantic.hard.load_hard_cohort (pooled-test testA+testB); reuse_frozen_construction; same sentence/ref/image/target across backbones

7_manipulation_metrics.bootstrap: image-clustered paired shift (hard vs rand), ccg.semantic.hard_eval.paired_shift_bootstrap, 5000 reps, seed 0, ci 0.95
7_manipulation_metrics.validity_rule: >=2/3 metrics correct direction AND >=1 metric CI excludes 0
7_manipulation_metrics.on_invalid: MANIPULATION_INVALID -> that backbone hard-amplification NOT_ASSESSABLE (never FAIL, never REPLICATED)

8_bootstrap_seed_draw_policy.amplification: ccg.semantic.hard_eval.paired_diff_of_diffs_bootstrap with the SAME cluster_ids + SAME seed for rand and hard -> shared draws across the four SampleStats blocks
8_bootstrap_seed_draw_policy.seed_handling: per-seed reported separately + 3-seed mean+-std; never concatenate seeds into one pool

9_g4_gate_thresholds.instability_flag: mean passes gate but only 1/3 seeds same direction -> mark INSTABILITY (report per-seed, not pooled-only)

10_dose_response_cohort.cell_source: ccg run_phase1f expb_m0/2/4/8 level_sample on same8 cohort, k=10
10_dose_response_cohort.role: secondary only, NOT in the overall gate
10_dose_response_cohort.note: reuse frozen cohort; never redefine cohort to chase a trend

r1_r2_definition.R1: Stats Logistic = LogisticModel(C in grid) on stat_features(scores, temperature=corrected_global_T) [n,17]
r1_r2_definition.R2: Stats+V2 Semantic Logistic = LogisticModel(C in grid) on hstack(stats17_std, v2_primary_semantic_stats(z_q,z_i,scores)_std) [n,31]
r1_r2_definition.models: 2 backbone x 3 seeds x 2 models = 12 fitted fresh

score_feature_temperature: all probability/entropy-bearing stats use the backbone+seed's OWN corrected global T (from eval_metadata.temperature_corrected); cosine semantic features are T-independent; native logit scale (100 / 117.331) is provenance only, never used as T
headline_comparison: Stats Logistic (R1) vs Stats+V2 Semantic Logistic (R2); MSP is secondary, not the headline
overall_gate: B0(B/32) Cardinality=YES & HardSemantic=YES (V1 frozen). >=2/3 backbones with BOTH cardinality AND hard-semantic replicated -> V2_METHOD_DEVELOPMENT_AUTHORIZED=YES. 3/3 with cardinality+valid-manipulation+hard-amplification -> STRONG CROSS-BACKBONE GENERALITY.
